note: Lincoln County park on a peninsula in Lake Benton with a swimming beach, two picnic shelters, a fish-cleaning shed and two boat launches. --Claude
summary: County parks page read: 92 sites (50 full hookup, 42 water/electric), $30 electric, seasonal $2,000/$1,700, showers, dump. Booking method not stated (stored reservable/operator left alone). Stored lakefront not supported for the bulk of the sites (tree band along the whole shore): recommend lakeview. Pin ~490 m south of the sites' centre. Note cleaned.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE lakefront -> lakeview (not --AWH): on Esri imagery all three site groups sit behind a continuous band of shoreline trees. North block (sites 1-53, centre ~44.2933,-96.2596): its east row is ~30-45 m from Lake Benton through trees. Shore strip (sites 1-15, ~44.2917,-96.2586): the east-side units are ~30-35 m from the water through a continuous 20-30 m tree band. South strip (1A-18A/1B-17B, ~44.2880,-96.2605): mostly treed to the shore. The one possible exception is an isolated lake-side pad near 44.2883,-96.2602 (on the county map this appears to be site 10A) with open grass running ~15-20 m to the shore; the county map's labels can't be matched to pads with confidence, and nothing says whether it is sold by the night. The stored evidence ('open grass ~20-40m to the waterline, unobstructed') is not what the current imagery shows for the RV rows. Default down; a reviewer could keep lakefront with a caveat on 10A only if the county confirms that pad.

LONG-STAY (information): the county sells season-long sites here ($2,000 full hookup, $1,700 no sewer, May 1 - Oct 15). On imagery the north block's 53 sites are densely filled with trailers that look like seasonal set-ups (decks, sheds). No county page says how many sites sell nights or how to book a night. Google 4.5 from 65 reviews (review text did not load). Not enough to call it mostly seasonal; a reviewer may want to phone the parks office (507-368-9350).
BOOKING: no county page says how campsites are booked (stored reservable true / platform operator came from the sweep note 'Reserve via county'); left alone.

PIN MOVE (~490 m): stored 44.28720,-96.26000 sits at the south end of the park by the day-use area and boat launch. The sites' centre (weighted over the three groups) is near 44.2915,-96.2588 on the campground road at the shore strip; propose that point.
